name: Plesiosuchus
sum: Large geosaurine metriorhynchid from the Late Jurassic of Dorset, England, and possibly Spain.
holotype: NHMUK PV OR40103, an incomplete skull with mandible and isolated postcranial remains found in the 1860s on the Dorset coast.
material: The type and referred specimens were found by John Clavell Mansel-Pleydell alongside remains of other large marine reptiles.
biology: Fully marine like other metriorhynchids; the skull was at first thought to be pliosaur.
author: Owen 1884
